newsitem.title: CHINA: China executes police official for corruption.
newsitem.headline: China executes police official for corruption.

text.p: A police official in the northeast China province of Liaoning has been executed for accepting more than 20 million yuan in bribes to facilitate projects in a local economic zone, the Liberation Daily said on Saturday.
The newspaper said Zhao Guoli was the deputy police chief of the zone in Jinzhou city, and from 1993 faked certificates and receipts in return for cash from various companies operating in the zone.
